nodes.title: SG-1.2.3 · Unit tests for the real UI store covering defaults and each action
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/store/uiStore.ts exports the zustand store useUiStore with drawerOpen, modal, soundEnabled, settingsOpen and the actions toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings. Tests exist in three files, each covering part of the store. Desired behavior: one unit-test suite asserts the complete default state and every action, and proves the tests import the actual store module rather than a mock of it. Why: closes sub-goal SG-1.2.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a freshly reset store, when state is read, then drawerOpen=false, modal=null, soundEnabled=true, settingsOpen=false and all five actions are functions.
- Given the real store, when each of toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings runs, then the matching state field changes as specified and unrelated fields stay unchanged.
- Given the test suite, when it runs, then it imports ../src/store/uiStore directly with no vi.mock of that module and asserts the imported hook is not a mock function.


## Scope
- In scope: New unit tests under game/frontend/tests for useUiStore
- Out of scope: Changing store behavior
- Out of scope: Component tests
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Existing uiStore*.test.ts files
- Preserve: uiStore.ts public API


## Technical constraints
- Vitest 2 with jsdom; tests live in game/frontend/tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} per vitest.config.ts
- Reset state with useUiStore.setState(useUiStore.getInitialState(), true)
- Unit tests only: no browser, server or live ports


## Definition of done
- New test file passes
- Tests import the real store, never a mock of it


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Default state and every action of the real store are asserted in one suite
nodes.body:
Context: existing tests split drawer/modal, sound/settings and hook subscription, and none asserts every default together or that actions are functions. Desired behavior: a consolidated suite covers defaults and each action, including double toggle returning to the default and openModal replacing then closeModal clearing the modal. Expected result: any regression in a default or action fails a named test. Why: complete coverage for SG-1.2.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the initial state, when read, then all four fields hold their defaults and five actions are functions.
- Given each toggle action called twice, when state is read after each call, then the value flips then returns to its default, leaving other fields unchanged.
- Given openModal('contribution') then closeModal(), when state is read after each, then modal is 'contribution' then null.


## Scope
- In scope: Default state and action assertions
- Out of scope: New store features
- Preserve: uiStore.ts behavior


## Technical constraints
- Real store only; reset via getInitialState between tests


## Definition of done
- All default and action assertions pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Tests are proven to use the actual store module, not a mock
nodes.body:
Context: the sub-goal requires confirming the tests import the actual store rather than a mock. Desired behavior: a test asserts vi.isMockFunction(useUiStore) is false, the module namespace exports useUiStore, and the source file of the suite contains no vi.mock call for the store. Expected result: replacing the store with a mock makes the guard test fail. Why: guarantees the unit tests exercise production code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the imported useUiStore, when vi.isMockFunction is called on it and on each action, then every result is false.
- Given the test file source read from disk, when searched for vi.mock, then no occurrence exists.
- Given the module namespace imported from ../src/store/uiStore, when its keys are read, then useUiStore is exported.


## Scope
- In scope: Guard assertions that the real module is used
- Out of scope: Behavioral store tests
- Preserve: uiStore.ts exports


## Technical constraints
- Read the test file with node:fs readFileSync of import.meta.url path; no network


## Definition of done
- Guard tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Verify: Real store defaults and each action unit tests
nodes.body:

## Acceptance criteria
- Given reset state, when read, then defaults and five function actions are asserted.
- Given each toggle twice, when read, then flip then restore is asserted with other fields unchanged.
- Given openModal then closeModal, when read, then 'contribution' then null.


## Scope
- In scope: tests/uiStoreReal.test.ts
- Out of scope: Product code edits
- Preserve: Existing uiStore tests


## Technical constraints
- Real store only; no browser or server


## Definition of done
- Test file passes via its own command


## Clarifying questions
- None
